== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Scanner Techs (Japanese)|Scanner Techs]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67674 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(22, 10, 471, 621)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>0a3248ad4408407f724ded94417e56b7ad7d7126b337bea67ccc83570731fcf0</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
